exposure: incorrect posture of foetal forelimbs and head
cohort: The study analyzed 72 cases of equine dystocia in mares and foals over a 10-year period.
finding: Multiple causes of dystocia in horses are almost as common as isolated causes, and neonatal mortality remains high.
mod_finding: Foetotomy was performed in 68% of cases, and a caesarean section or extraction was performed in 13.9% of cases.
